prs.title: Add public AUTOPILOT scheduler control-plane contracts
prs.head: autopilot-control-plane
prs.purpose_hint: Adds reusable public scheduler/control-plane primitives and regressions: machine-state validation, sticky lease enforcement, safe blocked-packet lease handoff, dependency-aware transitions, provider outcome classification, and explicit separation of account AI-capability restrictions from system/product failures. Public CI runs Ubuntu/Windows/macOS across Python 3.11-3.13 plus a scheduler-contract job, with per-branch concurrency cancelling superseded duplicate runs. Provider outcome contract treats account capability/auth/rate outcomes as account/pool health while stopping on explicit trust/safety denial. No private product state, credentials, cookies, runtime archives, account identifiers,

prs.title: Add synthetic F52 provider-independent proof harness
prs.head: worker-d/f52-proof-harness
prs.purpose_hint: Adds reusable public synthetic verification for the provider-independent portions of F42/F43/F46/F47/F48: capability/health fail-closed routing, result identity/generation/fence integrity, durable checkpoint identity across restore/requeue, stale-attempt fencing, and no conflicting duplicate completion. This evidence does not replace any required actual-provider proof. Branch Actions run 33803882373 is GREEN across the public matrix at exact head d9bec971e44575bad99c7eae9bceacce4118e62d. No private product source, provider credentials, cookies, runtime state, or secrets are included.

prs.title: Separate push and PR CI concurrency groups
prs.head: worker-d/f52-proof-harness
prs.purpose_hint: Fixes the reproduced integration-proof blocker where push and pull_request runs for the same branch shared one concurrency key and cancelled each other. The group now includes github.event_name, so replacement CI can complete independently. Exact branch head 0ff3a463baac2323dd7eccc1a886c92a34b81fb9 is GREEN in run 33804474238 across Ubuntu/Windows/macOS × Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 plus scheduler-contract. This is CI control-plane only; no private product/provider material is present.
